diameterInterpretation: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging, light curves and occultations, 79 ± 2 km volume-equivalent diameter. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Selected archive equivalent-diameter error; not a local shape-accuracy bound or automatically a one-sigma confidence interval.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Selected DAMIT archived solution volume-equivalent diameter, independently checked against raw mesh volume.
calibration.limitations: Hanuš 2017 fits optical light curves, two disk-resolved AO images and one 18-chord occultation. Archive D79±2 km is retained rather than paper ensemble D80±2 km. No resolved albedo or regolith map is supplied.
